meta.name: Generate Instagram GTA 6 news carousels with Gemini, Gotenberg and Google Drive

name: Generate Instagram news carousels from gaming articles using Gemini AI

parameters.content:
## Generate Instagram news carousels from gaming articles using Gemini AI

### How it works

This workflow manually fetches gaming news from a GTA6 news page, extracts recent article content, and sends the combined stories to Gemini for carousel-ready analysis. It turns the AI output into slide HTML, renders each slide as an image with Gotenberg, uploads the images to Google Drive, creates Instagram media containers, and finally publishes the assembled carousel through the Instagram Graph API.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Gemini credentials and ensure the AI prompt/model settings produce the expected slide structure.
- Set up Gotenberg at the configured URL, or update the Gotenberg HTTP request endpoint to match your environment.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and choose the destination folder for rendered slide images.
- Replace Instagram Graph API placeholders such as YOUR_IG_USER_ID and access tokens with valid Meta app values that have publishing permissions.
- Verify the source news URL and article parsing code still match the structure of the target website.

### Customization

Adjust the Limit node to change how many articles are included, update the Gemini prompt for different editorial style, and modify the slide HTML/CSS code to change the carousel design.

## Start and fetch source

Begins the workflow manually and retrieves the GTA6 news listing page that contains candidate article links.

## Parse and limit links

Extracts article links from the news page and limits the list before deeper article processing.

## Extract article stories

Fetches each selected article page, extracts usable story text, and aggregates the stories into a single input for AI analysis.

## Analyze and build slides

Uses Gemini to transform the aggregated news into carousel content, then converts that output into HTML for individual slide rendering.

## Render slide images

Loops through generated slide HTML, renders each slide image through Gotenberg, and waits briefly before upload processing continues.

## Upload and create containers

Uploads each rendered slide to Google Drive, makes it publicly accessible, and creates an Instagram media container for that slide before returning to the loop.

## Bundle and publish carousel

After all slides are processed, prepares the carousel payload, creates the Instagram carousel bundle, and publishes the final post.

options.systemMessage:
=You are the lead editor of a daily GTA 6 news roundup channel on Instagram. You receive today's scraped GTA 6 stories plus a log of already-posted topics.

Your job:
1. Pick 3 to 5 DISTINCT, high-quality stories. Skip anything previously posted. Prioritize official Rockstar info, confirmed gameplay features, and release news. 
2. For each story, write a slide: a SHORT, punchy headline (2 to 5 words MAX, written for large bold caps) and a one-sentence caption (max 15 words) that provides real context. Pick 1-2 short phrases from the caption worth visually emphasizing.
3. Write ONE ultra-punchy, high-energy hook headline for slide 1 that teases the roundup. MUST BE UNDER 6 WORDS. Make it urgent and clickable (e.g., "MASSIVE MAP LEAK", "NEW ENGINE DETAILS", "HUGE RUMOR CONFIRMED"). Do not use punctuation at the end.

Output STRICT JSON, no markdown:
{
  "hook_headline": "Ultra-punchy hook, max 6 words",
  "slides": [
    { "source_index": 0, "headline": "2-5 words max", "caption": "max 15 words", "highlights": ["phrase 1", "phrase 2"] }
  ],
  "caption": "Instagram caption ending in a question, include #GTA6 #Leonida",
  "topic_slugs": ["slug 1"]
}
